info.title: Private Community sharing groups
info.description: Invitation-only groups distinct from chat. Accepted current members read and publish text posts/comments. Owner invitations require accepted friendship, current eligibility and no bilateral block. Declined invitations cannot be resent. Text encrypted at rest. No public feed, search, media, health-data or realtime fan-out.
